messages: Carla: FYI CI is failing on docs/guides/setup.mdx and docs/ops/cache.mdx during the Docusaurus build. Linkcheck reports a missing anchor and the MDX parser errors on an admonition marker inside a code fence. Error snippet: Carla: ``` MDXParseError: Unexpected token at docs/guides/setup.mdx: line 42 linkcheck: broken link ../ops/cache#warm-start -> anchor not found ``` Ben: Which files/lines exactly? can you paste a tiny context? Carla: setup.mdx has a triple-backtick fenced example that includes a literal `:::note` (copied from a CONTRIBUTING snippet). The parser treats that as an admonition start. Also the cache page header is `## Warm starting` so the generated slug is `warm-starting`, but the link used `#warm-start` (missing the -ing). Alice: Seen this before. The options are: 1) escape the `:::` in the code fence (e.g. add a zero-width space) 2) move the admonition outside the fence 3) add an explicit header id on the target page like `## Warm starting {#warm-start}` or `## Warm starting `. The explicit id is the least invasive for backports. Greg: For immediate unblocking, adding an HTML id is fine. Long-term we should update CONTRIBUTING and examples to avoid unescaped admonition markers inside code blocks. Ben: I'll take this. Plan: a) replace `../ops/cache#warm-start` with `../ops/cache#warm-starting` in the referencing page b) move the `:::note` out of the fenced block in setup.mdx (or escape it) c) run the local linkcheck script `PYTHONPATH=. python -m scripts.linkcheck docs` before pushing. docs-ci: Ben's branch passed local linkcheck but remote CI failed due to cached build layers. Suggest clearing cache or bumping the actions/cache key. Ben: Pushed branch `docs/fix/mdx-admonition-anchor-1749`. Cleared CI cache, retriggered. CI build passed after cache clear. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4199 :white_check_mark: Carla: Thanks. Can you also open a backport PR to `release/v1.x` with just the HTML id shim? We still get customers hitting older docs. Ben: Yep will open `backport/fix-docs-1749` after merge. Alice: Adding a tiny CONTRIBUTING note in a follow-up PR: "Do not include raw admonition markers inside fenced code blocks; escape or surround with comments." Also adding a short blurb about how Docusaurus slugifies headings (so authors know `Warm starting` -> `warm-starting`). Carla: Great. Closing after backport merges. :tada:
